title: Equal mixed determinants against every frame force span inclusion of orthonormal frames
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let x = (x_1, …, x_n) and y = (y_1, …, y_n) be orthonormal families in ℝ^P (Orthonormal ℝ x, Orthonormal ℝ y). Assume that for every family w = (w_1, …, w_n) of vectors in ℝ^P (w : Fin n → Euclid P), det(⟨x_a, w_b⟩)_{a,b} = det(⟨y_a, w_b⟩)_{a,b}. Here (⟨u_a, w_b⟩)_{a,b} is the n×n real matrix with entry ⟨u_a, w_b⟩ in row a and column b (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (u a) (w b)). Then span{y_1, …, y_n} ⊆ span{x_1, …, x_n}, i.e. Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range y) ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x y : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ x → Orthonormal ℝ y → (∀ w : Fin n → Euclid P, Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (x a) (w b)) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (y a) (w b))) → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range y) ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x)
